oneLine: Airtel Money plans a London listing aiming to raise $800 million via an OFS.

sources.title: Airtel Money plans biggest London listing since 2021

synopsis: Airtel Money, the fintech arm of Bharti Airtel Ltd operating across sub-Saharan Africa, plans to list on the London Stock Exchange through an offer for sale by current shareholders. While official figures were not disclosed, reports cite plans to raise at least $800 million at a valuation of $8-9 billion, marking potentially the largest new listing on the LSE since 2021. The offer consists solely of shares sold by existing shareholders, with no new capital being raised by the company. Existing minority investors include TPG, Mastercard, the Qatar Investment Authority, and Chimetech Holding Ltd, while Airtel Africa holds a 77.85% stake. The company reported $1.35 billion in revenue and a profit of $373 million for FY26.
